name: Caspian Tern
description: The Caspian Tern is the world's largest tern, with a substantial red bill, pale body, and dark crown. It uses both coastal and inland waters, searching for fish from the air before diving toward the surface. Its strong proportions and deep, raspy calls help separate it from smaller terns. Breeding colonies occupy open ground near productive feeding waters. A bird passing overhead provides a clear view of the broad wings and heavy bill that characterize this powerful seabird.

references.title: Cornell Lab of Ornithology: All About Birds
